## readSealsSync() function

Read seals from the seals file (sync).

Supports both YAML (.yaml) and JSON (.json) formats. When no override path is provided, prefers seals.yaml over seals.json.

Uses Zod schema from the migration graph for validation.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function readSealsSync(dir: string, sealsPathOverride?: string): SealsFile;
```
